model.name: FLUX.2 Klein 4B — Uncensored Text Encoder (Experimental)
model.description: Experimental exact-family FLUX.2 Klein 4B variant. It reuses the Apache-2.0 Klein 4B image checkpoint and swaps only the Qwen3 conditioning encoder for the pinned ponpoke uncensored text encoder. That encoder repository is separately gated under FLUX non-commercial v2.1 terms. The artifact size is recorded from repository metadata; its content SHA-256 is unavailable until an authorized download and is not claimed as verified.
